allow: PowerShell(foreach \($n in 1745,1761,1777,1793\) { "--- around line $n ---"; Get-Content src\\App.tsx | Select-Object -Skip \($n-3\) -First 12 | ForEach-Object { "  " + $_.Trim\(\) } ; "" })

PowerShell($m = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/src/main.tsx' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15\).Content; if \($m -match 'process'\) { 'main.tsx mentions process' } else { 'main.tsx: no process reference' }; '--- any global process shim in index.html? ---'; $h = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/' -UseBasicParsing\).Content; if \($h -match 'process'\) { \($h -split "`n" | Select-String 'process' | ForEach-Object { '  ' + $_.Line.Trim\(\) }\) } else { '  none' })

PowerShell($c = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/@vite/client' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15\).Content; if \($c -match 'process'\) { \($c -split "`n" | Select-String 'process' | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { '  ' + $_.Line.Trim\(\) }\) } else { '  /@vite/client: no process shim' }; '--- full raw index.html ---'; \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/' -UseBasicParsing\).Content)
